title: Prescription Delivery Service: How Seniors Get Medicine Without Leaving Home
summary: How prescription delivery works for seniors: your options, how to spot a safe online pharmacy, and how GoGoGrandparent delivers medicine by phone.
body_markdown:
A prescription delivery service picks up medicine from the pharmacy and brings it to the front door. With GoGoGrandparent, one phone call to1 (855) 464-6872 arranges it. No app, no smartphone, and no drive across town when you're under the weather or the sidewalks are icy.


Fall and winter are when this matters most. Colds go around, the days get shorter, and a quick pharmacy run can turn into a real outing. This guide covers the main ways to get prescriptions delivered, how GoGoGrandparent's service works step by step, and what to sort out before the first delivery.


## **What are the options for prescription delivery?**


The right prescription delivery option depends on how quickly the medicine is needed and which pharmacy fills it. There's no single best choice.


- **Mail-order pharmacy.** Some Medicare drug plans offer[a mail-order program](https://www.medicare.gov/health-drug-plans/part-d/what-drug-plans-cover/pharmacies) that sends up to a 3-month supply of the drugs you take regularly straight to your home. It's built for steady refills, so it's not the answer for a new prescription needed today.
- **The pharmacy's own delivery.** Some pharmacies deliver in certain areas. Availability varies a lot from store to store, so ask at the counter next time you pick something up.
- **A family member or neighbor.** Familiar and free, but it depends on someone else's schedule.
- **A senior-friendly delivery service.**[GoGoGrandparent's prescription delivery](https://www.gogograndparent.com/services/prescription-delivery) picks up from the pharmacy you already use and is arranged entirely by phone.


## **How can you tell if an online pharmacy is safe?**


Online pharmacies are another route to pharmacy delivery, but not all of them are legitimate. The FDA's advice is to[check the pharmacy's license with your state board of pharmacy](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/besaferx-your-source-online-pharmacy-information/locate-state-licensed-online-pharmacy) , and if it isn't listed, don't use it. A safe online pharmacy will:


- Require a doctor's prescription.
- Provide a physical address and telephone number in the United States.
- Have a licensed pharmacist available to answer your questions.


A site offering prescription medicine with no prescription needed is a warning sign, however good the price looks.


## **How does GoGoGrandparent prescription delivery work?**


The whole process takes four steps:


1. **Call the pharmacy** to confirm the prescription is ready for pickup.
2. **Call GoGoGrandparent** at1 (855) 464-6872 and press 7 for delivery from pharmacies.
3. **An operator places the delivery order** and confirms the details with you.
4. **The prescription arrives** at the address you choose.


GoGoGrandparent can pick up from pharmacies that allow third-party pickup. Not every location does, even within the same chain, so ask your pharmacy first.


## **What should you know before your first prescription delivery?**


A few details make the first delivery go smoothly.


- **Pay the pharmacy first.** Drivers can't carry or process payment cards, so settle the bill with the pharmacy by phone before pickup.
- **Tell the pharmacy someone is coming.** Let them know a driver will pick up the prescription on your behalf.
- **Insurance works the usual way.** Prescription coverage is handled by the pharmacy as it normally is. GoGoGrandparent doesn't bill insurance.
- **Call before closing time.** Place the order at least 30 minutes before the pharmacy closes.
- **Controlled medications aren't included.** Narcotics and other controlled medications are excluded from the service, so those still need a pharmacy visit or another arrangement.


Drivers can only pick up during the store's normal open hours, so plan the call for a time when your pharmacy is open.


## **When does medicine delivery make the most sense?**


Some people use prescription delivery every month. Others keep the number handy for the days when getting out is harder than usual. A few common ones:


- **You're sick.** Waiting in a pharmacy line with a fever is nobody's idea of a good afternoon.
- **The weather turns.** Ice, snow, or heavy rain makes a short trip risky.
- **You've just had a procedure.** A new prescription after an outpatient procedure often needs picking up when you're in no shape to drive.
- **A family member lives far away.** Once a relative is added to the account as someone who can make requests, they can call and arrange delivery for you.


Prescription delivery also pairs well with the rest of GoGoGrandparent. The same phone number arranges[grocery delivery for seniors](https://www.gogograndparent.com/services/groceries-for-seniors) , so the medicine and the milk can both come to you. And when an appointment can't be skipped, GoGoGrandparent arranges rides too. The guide to[senior rides to the doctor](https://www.gogograndparent.com/blog/senior-rides-to-the-doctors-how-to-catch-a-ride) covers which kind of ride fits which visit.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **Do I need an app for prescription delivery?**


No. GoGoGrandparent's prescription delivery service is arranged by phone: call 1(855) 464-6872 and press 7 for delivery.


### **Which pharmacies does GoGoGrandparent pick up from?**


Pharmacies that allow third-party pickup. Policies can differ by location, so check with yours first.


### **Can a family member arrange prescription delivery for me?**


Yes, once they've been added to your account as someone who can make requests.


### **Can every medication be delivered?**


Most can, but narcotics and controlled medications are excluded.
